svg.title: One input, two answers from the C
svg.desc: x = 0x5f201b45bbc5eac3 and y = 0x5f201b45fffffffe share their high 32 bits. fdlibm 5.3's C returns 5f26c7304042d062 for hypot(x, y) and 5f26c7304042d063 for hypot(y, x). StrictMath.hypot and Math.hypot return 5f26c7304042d063 in both orders on JDK 17, 21, 25.
